reason: The plugin is primarily a UI theme enhancer for the DSH Web interface: it defines and applies an alternative visual skin by injecting styles and theme tokens, with light/dark support, fitting the themes-layout category. The provided evidence consistently points to front-end appearance customization only, with no documented external service integration or data-processing scope.

summaries.zh: 该插件面向 DSH Web 提供可直接应用的界面主题皮肤，安装后可替换页面的视觉样式并支持浅色/深色模式。
summaries.en: This plugin is a client-side theme extension for DSH Web that applies an alternate interface skin and supports switching between light and dark visual styles.

capabilities: Provides a client-side UI skin/theme overlay for DSH Web.
Overrides design tokens (`--dsw-*`) to switch visual styling between light and dark sets.
Injects CSS and optional decorative layers without requiring backend or external data flows.

reasons.code: README states this is a DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme skin plugin and explicitly labels it a pure client plugin that changes skin after installation without modifying DSH core.
